requirements.text: A petri net model has nets
A petri net model contains arcs. Each arc has a weight
A Place-to-Transition Arc belongs to PetriNet package
A Transition-to-Place Arc is a class that belongs to PetriNet package
A Place is present in one and only one Petri Net
A petri net has places that are in zero or more TP arcs
in a petri net, each transition must be linked to a net
A Transition has one or several outgoing Transition-to-Arc Arcs
A Petri Net is composed of one or several Places
A Place-to-Transition Arc has one and only one destination Transition
A Transition-to-Place Arc is associated to one and only one Transition
